info.title: Polymorfa Functions API contract subset
info.description: Functions operations and transitive schemas from the recorded source revision.

get.description:
Lists one project's Functions with bounded pagination.

Requires `functions:read`. Project tokens only access resources in their own project.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

post.description:
Creates a Function definition. A supplied functionId preserves identity when retrying creation.

Requires `functions:manage`. Project tokens only access resources in their own project. Dashboard callers must be a team owner or admin.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

get.description:
Reads a Function definition and its active deployment.

Requires `functions:read`. Project tokens only access resources in their own project.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

patch.description:
Updates name or enabled state when expectedRevision matches. Disabling prevents new invocations; already running code can finish.

Requires `functions:manage`. Project tokens only access resources in their own project. Dashboard callers must be a team owner or admin.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

delete.description:
Disables and retires the Function. Historical identities are not reused.

Requires `functions:manage`. Project tokens only access resources in their own project. Dashboard callers must be a team owner or admin.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

get.description:
Lists immutable Function deployment metadata and secret version references. Retrieve one deployment to read its source.

Requires `functions:read`. Project tokens only access resources in their own project.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

post.description:
Builds bounded self-contained source or visual actions. Only the portable Functions helper is available as an import. No dependency installation occurs during execution. Reusing deploymentId with different configuration conflicts.

Requires `functions:manage`. Project tokens only access resources in their own project. Dashboard callers must be a team owner or admin.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

get.description:
Reads one immutable Function deployment. Secret plaintext is never returned.

Requires `functions:read`. Project tokens only access resources in their own project.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

put.description:
Changes the default deployment using an expected revision. Pinned invocations retain their selected deployment.

Requires `functions:manage`. Project tokens only access resources in their own project. Dashboard callers must be a team owner or admin.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

get.description:
Returns secret names, version identities and revocation timestamps. Secret values are write-only.

Requires `functions:read`. Project tokens only access resources in their own project.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

post.description:
Creates an encrypted secret version. Deployments explicitly pin versions; creating a new version does not replace an existing deployment's secret. Polymorfa credentials are refused.

Requires `functions:manage`. Project tokens only access resources in their own project. Dashboard callers must be a team owner or admin.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

delete.description:
Prevents new invocations of deployments that reference this version. Running invocations can finish.

Requires `functions:manage`. Project tokens only access resources in their own project. Dashboard callers must be a team owner or admin.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

get.description:
Returns invocation metadata without input, response or customer log content.

Requires `functions:read`. Project tokens only access resources in their own project.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

post.description:
Executes one immutable deployment with a required Idempotency-Key. Repeating the key returns metadata only and never runs customer effects again. Input and response content are not retained. A reused key with a different request conflicts. Unknown outcomes require application-level reconciliation.

Requires `functions:invoke`. Project tokens only access resources in their own project. Dashboard callers must be a team owner or admin.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

get.description:
Returns the invocation receipt. A lost result is uncertain and must not be automatically retried.

Requires `functions:read`. Project tokens only access resources in their own project.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

ApiKeyAuth.description: Send your team API key or project token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The credential must have the required permissions. Project tokens can access only their own project.

ConsoleSession.description: Verified dashboard JWT for signed-in Console requests. This is not a server credential.

PropagationPending.description: The change was stored, but a connected number has not confirmed it. Retry the request; the stored setting is already correct and is retried automatically.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with the resource's current state.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

NotFound.description: The requested resource was not found inside the authenticated team or project scope.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated but lacks the required scope/role/audience.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.
API version applied to this response.

BadRequest.description: A path, query, or request-body value did not pass validation.

Polymorfa-Version.description: API version applied to this response.

code.description: Stable failure code. Use this value for programmatic handling.

param.description: Invalid request field, or null when no field applies.

request_id.description: Matches the X-Request-Id response header. Include it when you contact support.

request_log_url.description: Console page that shows this request. Returned only to organization and project credentials whose request was logged.

data.description: Always null for a failed request.

docs.description: Documentation link to this failure code.

retryable.description: True only when execution did not start. Use a new idempotency key to make a new attempt; the original key always returns its receipt.

bodyBase64.description: Base64-encoded UTF-8 or binary bytes. Invocation bodies are not retained.

url.description: Synthetic URL with origin https://function.polymorfa.invalid. It does not choose a network destination.

bodyBase64.description: Base64-encoded request bytes. GET and HEAD requests require an empty string. Invocation bodies are not retained.
